grammar:
char ::= [^"\\\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
space ::= [ \t\n\r]*
root ::= response-format-schema
response-format-schema ::= "{" space "\"target\"" space ":" space target "," space "\"reason\"" space ":" space reason ("," space "\"failure_risks\"" space ":" space risks)? space "}"
target ::= ("\"newbie\"" | "\"illustrious\"" | "\"anima\"" | "\"z_image_turbo\"")
reason ::= "\"" char{3,900} "\""
risk ::= "\"" char{3,300} "\""
risks ::= "[" space (risk ("," space risk){0,2})? space "]"

transformation.changed: Explicit text-only initial selection grammar; unchanged complete consumer schema
transformation.unchanged: Exact target enum, required target/reason, optional 0..3 risks, original string bounds and host nonblank validation
transformation.length_scope: reason 3..900 and risk 3..300 JSON characters; unchanged Pydantic validates decoded string bounds without truncation or repair
transformation.source_runtime_scope: Binding inherited from the same installed build; no model/starting-choice response is claimed
